enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sigh. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene (washing face, brushing teeth, showering)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Put eggs on plate. Place plate on table. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Put keys in bag. Pick up wallet. Put wallet in bag. Walk to door. Open door. Walk out. Close door.

Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office. Open office door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open patient files. Review patient charts. Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Take patient history. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Prescribe medication. Write notes. Walk to nurses station. Discuss patient with nurse. Update records. Attend meeting.

Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to exit. Open door. Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Close cupboard. Turn on induction cooker. Place pot on cooker. Add water. Add vegetables. Add meat. Cook soup. Turn off induction cooker. Pour soup into bowl. Place bowl on table. Sit at table. Eat soup. Drink water.

Walk to living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type document. Save document. Open social media. Scroll feed. Like posts. Comment on post. Close social media. Open game. Play game. Exit game. Turn off computer. Stand up. Stretch.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to sink. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Open phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Scroll social media. Watch video. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down.

Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Breathe in. Breathe out. Fall asleep.

Lie on back. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sigh. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.
